title: Identification of cycles, boundaries and homology of alternating exact rows
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $S$ a cochain complex over $\mathbb Z$, and $R$ a compatible row system [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-rows]. Let $A_R$ be its associated complex and $e:S\to A_R$ its augmentation. There are isomorphisms $z^p:Z^p(A_R)\cong R.Z^p$, $b^p:\operatorname{im}(d_{A_R}^{p-1})\cong R.D^p$, $h^p:H^p(A_R)\cong R.H^p$, such that the induced cycle, image and homology maps of $e$, followed by these isomorphisms, equal respectively $R.j_Z^p$, $R.j_D^p$ and $R.j_H^p$. There is no injectivity, resolution or boundedness hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 015I, proof conclusion: verification of the composite differential

proof.text: The monomorphism w^(p+1)u^(p+1) lets the first short exact row identify u^p as a kernel of v^pw^(p+1)u^(p+1). Construct its limit fork and use LeftHomologyData.cyclesIso to identify the cycles.
Transport v^(p-1) to a map into D^p. It is epic, and w^pu^p is monic; their composite is the differential. image.isoStrongEpiMono identifies the image with D^p.

The lifted incoming differential is v^(p-1)w^p. Since v^(p-1) is epic, the second short exact row identifies x^p as its cokernel. Construct LeftHomologyData and use its homologyIso, compatible with the cycle isomorphism and the homology projection.
Cancel the cycle and image monomorphisms using naturality and commZ/commD. Cancel the source homology projection using homology naturality and commH. This proves all augmentation identities.
